title: Film Genres
description: Common film genres with a short description and a representative example film.

results.name: Action
results.description: Films centered on physical feats, chases, fights, and high-stakes sequences.

results.name: Adventure
results.description: Stories of journeys, quests, and exploration in exotic or dangerous settings.

results.name: Comedy
results.description: Films designed primarily to amuse and provoke laughter.

results.name: Drama
results.description: Character-driven films focused on realistic emotional and interpersonal conflict.

results.name: Horror
results.description: Films intended to frighten, shock, or unsettle the audience.

results.name: Thriller
results.description: Suspenseful films that keep audiences tense through danger and uncertainty.

results.name: Science Fiction
results.description: Speculative films exploring futuristic technology, space, and imagined science.

results.name: Fantasy
results.description: Films set in magical worlds with supernatural elements and mythical beings.
results.example_film: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

results.name: Romance
results.description: Films centered on love stories and the relationships between characters.

results.name: Mystery
results.description: Films built around solving a crime or uncovering a hidden truth.

results.name: Crime
results.description: Films focused on criminals, law enforcement, and the underworld.

results.name: Western
results.description: Films set in the American Old West emphasizing frontier life and lawlessness.
results.example_film: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

results.name: War
results.description: Films depicting armed conflict and its impact on soldiers and civilians.

results.name: Musical
results.description: Films in which song and dance numbers are integral to the narrative.

results.name: Animation
results.description: Films created frame by frame using drawn, computer, or model imagery.

results.name: Documentary
results.description: Non-fiction films presenting real people, events, and factual subjects.

results.name: Film Noir
results.description: Stylized crime dramas marked by moral ambiguity and shadowy visuals.

results.name: Biographical
results.description: Dramatized films recounting the life of a real historical figure.

results.name: Historical
results.description: Films set in and dramatizing events from the past.

results.name: Superhero
results.description: Films following costumed heroes with extraordinary powers battling villains.

results.name: Disaster
results.description: Films depicting large-scale catastrophes and survival against them.

results.name: Sports
results.description: Films centered on athletes, competition, and the world of sport.

results.name: Coming-of-Age
results.description: Films tracing a young protagonist's growth into maturity.

results.name: Road Movie
results.description: Films structured around a journey along the road as a path of self-discovery.

results.name: Heist
results.description: Films built around planning and executing an elaborate robbery.

results.name: Spy
results.description: Films following espionage agents amid intrigue and international stakes.

results.name: Romantic Comedy
results.description: Light-hearted films blending love stories with humor.

results.name: Psychological Thriller
results.description: Thrillers that emphasize mental tension, paranoia, and unstable perception.

results.name: Epic
results.description: Grand-scale films with sweeping settings, large casts, and long runtimes.

results.name: Slasher
results.description: Horror subgenre in which a killer stalks and murders a series of victims.
